message: 輝け友情！

name: Nanaka
message: 「Yaaaawn...」

name: Paqy
message: 「That's one huge yawn」

name: Sacchin
message: 「Looks like my fist could practically fit inside--」

name: Nanaka
message: 「As if it would!」
She managed to transform without any trouble during yesterday's special training, so it's probably not like she's feeling sick, though.

name: Nanaka
message: 「What's wrong with a little yawn? It's not like it wears anything out. Don't sweat the small stuff」

name: Eddie
message: 「My dad's second older brother's friend's acquaintance's grandpa used to say that if you yawn too much, your jaw'll dislocate」

name: Nanaka
message: 「What the heck kind of distant connection is that」

name: Synn
message: 「You've been like this all week, are you okay? Not getting enough sleep is bad for you, you know?」

name: Nanaka
message: 「I told you, there's nothing to worry about」
I stared intently at Nanaka.

name: Nanaka
message: 「B-Because I don't have the time...」

name: Synn
message: 「Huh?」

name: Nanaka
message: 「S-Shut up already. You looked pretty sleepy yourself the other day, Synn」

name: Synn
message: 「Th-That was...」

name: Paqy
message: 「I told ya it was porn, didn't I? Porn」

name: Nanaka
message: 「Your place doesn't even have a VCR, let alone a DVD player」

name: Nanaka
message: 「Everyone's got stuff they don't wanna talk about, so I held back from pressing you on it, though」

name: Synn
message: 「I already told you, it was my game console!」

name: Nanaka
message: 「You barely own any games, and you've already played all of 'em until you got sick of 'em, right? I know full well you wouldn't pull an all-nighter gaming at this point!」

name: Synn
message: 「Urk... That's why I said--」

name: Eddie
message: 「Actually, to come clean about it, we were having a viewing party over at my place」

name: Synn
message: 「...Of what?」

name: Eddie
message: 「When guys watch something together, what else could it be?」

name: Sacchin
message: 「Erotica?」

name: Eddie
message: 「Yep, yep. We watched tons of it all night long」

name: Eddie
message: 「By the way, the one that got Synn twitching the most was 'Sanae Kurokawa Mega-Boobs Series: Oh, Ma'am, Those Armpits Are Irresistible Squad'」

name: Nanaka
message: 「...I-Is that so... thank goodness... so he's not into that kind of thing after all...」

name: Sacchin
message: 「Oh-ho」

name: Synn
message: 「W-What is with that blatantly shady, totally tasteless title!」

name: Paqy
message: 「As expected of Lord Synn, that's intense! Way too intense!」

name: Nanaka
message: 「Still... he's into older women... urgh... I-I won't lose」

name: Eddie
message: 「Especially when dark, bushy armpit hair showed up, he was snorting 'huff―huff' super heavily, and sitting next to him I was totally helpless―」

name: Nanaka
message: 「Aah, enough already, I don't want to hear another word, talk to you, or come near you! Speak and I'll punch you!」

name: Eddie
message: 「Ouch!」

name: Sacchin
message: 「She's punching him. Ah, Nana-chan, wait up~」

name: Paqy
message: 「We avoided getting grilled」

name: Eddie
message: 「Hmph. Looks like that worked. It seemed like Yugiri suspected Synn of cheating, so I threw him a lifeline!」
Eddie shot me a crisp thumbs-up!

name: Eddie
message: 「Gladly accept this eternal friendship!」

name: Synn
message: 「I'd like to return it immediately」

name: Eddie
message: 「So cruel!」

name: Synn
message: 「Hey, what's gotten into Nanaka lately? You know something, don't you, Sacchin?」
I secretly called Sacchin over.

name: Sacchin
message: 「Curious~?」

name: Synn
message: 「Of course I am」

name: Sacchin
message: 「Because you're childhood friends~?」

name: Synn
message: 「...Yeah」

name: Sacchin
message: 「I see~ So if you weren't childhood friends, you wouldn't be worried~」

name: Synn
message: 「That's not true! Besides, we've been childhood friends from the start, so that question doesn't even make sense」

name: Paqy
message: 「Basically, Lord Synn is indiscriminately kind, after all」

name: Synn
message: 「You think so?」

name: Sacchin
message: 「Because you're like that with everyone, right~? It makes Nana-chan all flustered, you know~」

name: Synn
message: 「Flustered?」

name: Sacchin
message: 「B~ut, isn't the real reason she's so bothered because you two kissed~」

name: Synn
message: 「W-W-W-W-W-W-Wha--」
C-Calm down, Synn!
Sacchin is Nanaka's best friend, so it's no surprise she heard about it.
No surprise at all, it's nothing.

name: Synn
message: 「T-T-That was an accident! It's not like the two of us meant to...」

name: Sacchin
message: 「Every accident has a cause, you know~」

name: Synn
message: 「That's only because I woke up all of a sudden」

name: Paqy
message: 「On the surface, yes」

name: Sacchin
message: 「Seems like it~ But is that really all there is to it~」

name: Synn
message: 「T-That's all! W-What else could there possibly be!?」

name: Sacchin
message: 「You're totally rattled~ Ooh, aah, heh~」

name: Synn
message: 「Ahem. So, uh, what is Nanaka getting so flustered about?」

name: Sacchin
message: 「Obviously it's a secret~」
I actually had the rude thought that Sacchin might accidentally let the secret slip. Sorry.

name: Sacchin
message: 「You see~ Since I'm probably, like, Nana-chan's best friend, I've got a code of honor to uphold~」

name: Synn
message: 「The 'like' part kind of throws me off, though」
